shader_state_chamber.name: What stays when you let go?
shader_state_chamber.description: Draw a retained concentration on a wall, hold it, advance one Gray–Scott update, or run. The same stored field dresses a sphere and cube; nearby Memory Skin is a moving-noise counterexample.
interactions: Touch the wall or point and press to mark
RESET the three seeds or CLEAR the field
shader_state_chamber.qfep_connection: A surface can look marked without retaining an encounter. Here input, retained concentrations, update rule and colour interpretation have distinct owners. Uniformity needs an introduced difference before a pattern can spread.
